Name: ENEMY_COMMON_PARAM_ST
Description: Global enemy AI settings: awareness and engagement levels, target sharing, platoon roles, posture gauges, wall-collision and slope checks.

Fields.Name: Never Forget Distance when on Ladder (TARGET_ENE_0)
Fields.Description: When TARGET_ENE_0 is on a ladder, if the height difference with the enemy itself is within this value, the target will not be forgotten.

Fields.Name: Ceiling Check Distance for Floor Integration
Fields.Description: Only while the enemy is within this distance of the local player is the floor integration lift height worked out with the ceiling height taken into account.

Fields.Name: Wall Collision Interrupt Flag: Judgement Angle
Fields.Description: Threshold value of the angle between the wall normal and the movement direction (opposite direction). In degrees.

Fields.Name: Wall Collision Interrupt Flag: Judgment Duration
Fields.Description: How long a wall collision must last before the interrupt flag is issued. Larger values delay the flag; smaller values make false triggers more likely. In seconds.

Fields.Name: Wall Collision Interrupt Flag: Allowable Interruption Time
Fields.Description: Longest break in a wall collision that is still treated as one continuous collision, since wall collisions can drop in and out because of the system or terrain. In seconds.

Fields.Name: Judgement Duration for Forced Lift when Stuck on Slope
Fields.Description: If the enemy stays stuck on a slope for longer than this, a forced lift or snap update is done, depending on the NPC param settings. In seconds.

Fields.Name: Phantom ID: Time-based Activation
Fields.Description: Phantom shader faded in and out for the appearance and disappearance of enemies placed only for specific time periods.

Fields.Name: Awareness Decay Start Time to Upper Limit
Fields.Description: Enemy search level Decay start time to upper limit. In seconds.

Fields.Name: Awareness: Change to Discovery State Trigger
Fields.Description: Enemy search level that shifts to complete discovery state.

Fields.Name: Awareness: Change to Normal State Trigger
Fields.Description: Awareness level at which the enemy returns to the normal state.

Fields.Name: Awareness Decrease: Grace Duration (Normal)
Fields.Description: Grace time until enemy search level decreases - Normal (in seconds).

Fields.Name: Awareness Decrease: Grace Duration (Damage)
Fields.Description: Grace time until enemy search level decreases - During Damage (in seconds).

Fields.Name: Max Awareness
Fields.Description: Maximum enemy search level.

Fields.Name: Engagement: Grace Duration
Fields.Description: Grace time before the engagement level starts to decrease (in the newer system, used for perception). In seconds.

Fields.Name: Engagement: Decrease per Second
Fields.Description: The amount of engagement level that decreases every second.

Fields.Name: Target Sharing: Grace Duration
Fields.Description: Grace time before sharing target. In seconds.

Fields.Name: Sense: Engagement Decrease per Second
Fields.Description: Rate at which the engagement level built up from sight, hearing and being hit decreases. In points per second.

Fields.Name: Scan: Engagement Decrease per Second
Fields.Description: Rate at which the engagement level built up from radar decreases. In points per second.

Fields.Name: Scan: Engagement Decrease Grace Duration
Fields.Description: Grace time until engagement level decreases (radar). In seconds.

Fields.Name: Awareness Reduction per Second
Fields.Description: Decreased amount of enemy search level per second.

Fields.Name: Posture: Body Gauge
Fields.Description: Points of the body posture gauge.

Fields.Name: Posture: Action Gauge
Fields.Description: Points of the action posture gauge.

Fields.Name: Posture Recovery: Wait Time
Fields.Description: Time to wait before posture starts to recover. In seconds.

Fields.Name: Posture Recovery: Points per Second
Fields.Description: Posture points recovered per second.

Fields.Name: Stunlock Escape Threshold
Fields.Description: Points at which the enemy breaks out of a stunlock (being hit repeatedly without a chance to act).

Fields.Name: Platoon Follower: Role Evaluation Interval
Fields.Description: Time interval for evaluating platoon follower roles. In seconds.

Fields.Name: Attacker Battle Limit Distance
Fields.Description: Within this distance, attacker roles are handed out with priority on the character that is locked on to. In metres.

Fields.Name: Smooth Patrol: Route Correction Radius Limit
Fields.Description: Radius used to correct the patrol route when it is smoothed.

Fields.Name: Shared Target Recognition Delay Error
Fields.Description: Delay time = shared target recognition delay + random( 0, shared target recognition delay error). In seconds.

Fields.Name: Impact Invincibility Time
Fields.Description: How long impact is ignored after leaving a state set to grant impact invincibility on exit. In seconds.
